overview: The Medford City Council held a public hearing approving the Year 41 CDBG application and Five-Year Consolidated Plan, and addressed resolutions concerning Chevalier Auditorium, local business permitting, school department funding, and community access television.

items.title: Commendations for Medford High School Boys Hockey Team
items.summary: The council presented commendations to the Medford High School varsity boys hockey team for winning the Greater Boston League title and honored players Andrew Cronin and Adrian Perrazzo for receiving the MIAA Boston Bruins Sportsmanship Award.

items.title: Public Hearing on Year 41 CDBG Application and Five-Year Consolidated Plan
items.summary: Approved the Year 41 Community Development Block Grant application for $1,433,774 and the Five-Year Consolidated Plan following a public hearing presentation.

items.title: Recognition of Officer John Ghislaine
items.summary: Resident Anthony D'Antonio recognized Medford Police Officer John Ghislaine on the 40th anniversary of the Saigon embassy evacuation, prompting the council to vote to adjourn the meeting in honor of his military service.

items.title: Resolution on Chevalier Auditorium Marquee
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the city explore purchasing a permanent marquee for Chevalier Auditorium based on the design used during a recent film production.

items.title: Common Victualler's License for Annie's Pizzeria
items.summary: Approved a common victualler's license application for Annie's Pizzeria, LLC at 213 Middlesex Avenue.

items.title: Keno License Petition for Spring Street Superette
items.summary: Tabled a petition for a Keno monitor license at Spring Street Superette.

items.title: Reappointment of James Tirrani
items.summary: Approved the reappointment of James Tirrani to the Board of Trust Fund Commissioners.

items.title: Discussion on Office of Mayor and Budget Director Resignation
items.summary: Placed on file a resolution discussing potential conflicts of interest regarding the Budget Director's mayoral candidacy and resignation timeline.

items.title: Resolution on Snappy Patty Restaurant Activities
items.summary: Referred a resolution concerning unauthorized patio construction and liquor license compliance at Snappy Patty Restaurant to the Building Department, Liquor Commission, and Board of Health.

items.title: Resolution on School Department Budget and Operations
items.summary: Approved a multi-part resolution requesting School Department records on hires, raises, entrance repairs, and vocational school status, as well as requesting a joint meeting with the School Committee.

items.title: First Responder Narcan Implementation Update
items.summary: Received an update that the police patrolmen's association has agreed to carry Narcan while policy, medical oversight, and training are finalized.

items.title: Presentation on Participatory Budgeting
items.summary: Referred a petition introducing participatory budgeting to the Budget Director for review.

items.title: Committee of the Whole Report on Parking Management Program
items.summary: Approved a Committee of the Whole report detailing financial performance and recommendations regarding the city's parking management contract with Republic Parking.

items.title: Condolences to Family of Rayanne Conway Forbes
items.summary: Passed a resolution extending sympathy to Rayanne Conway Forbes on the passing of her mother.

items.title: Resolution Supporting House Bill 2847 on Community Access Television
items.summary: Tabled a resolution endorsing state legislation regarding municipal community access television funding and administration.
